name: Mohit-Rajput
description: Modern developer portfolio built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Vite, featuring cinematic UI, accessibility-first design, and high-performance web experiences.

paragraphs: A modern, responsive portfolio showcasing my work as a front-end developer with Salesforce expertise. Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Vite, the portfolio highlights enterprise Salesforce projects, certifications, technical articles, and interactive UI experiences.
features: Multi-page experience: Home, Projects, Experience, Skills, Achievements, Articles, Contact and Résumé

A dedicated page for every client project (/projects/:slug) and article summary (/blog/:slug), with hover effects, back-navigation scroll restoration and cross-links between roles, projects and articles
Contact page with a draggable, physics-driven Wipro ID card on a lanyard (black ribbon in the dark theme, blue in the light theme)
Fully responsive layouts with graceful fallbacks for small and short screens

whatItDoes.text: A modern, responsive portfolio showcasing my work as a front-end developer with Salesforce expertise. Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Vite, the portfolio highlights enterprise Salesforce projects, certifications, technical articles, and interactive UI experiences.

requirements.text: /admin (Supabase sign-in) edits the content tables live, with no deploy needed: Experience (with role documents), Skills, Certifications, Superbadges, Projects, Engagement cards, Articles, FAQ and Numbers & tags (Trailhead figures, impact numbers, hero tags).

Delivery uses Resend: create a free account with that same email address, create an API key and add it as the RESENDAPIKEY environment variable in Netlify (Site configuration → Environment variables).
